Detailed Description

Common parameters for bot transmissions (linear transmissions and spatial tendons).

Holds fields shared by transmission-like actuators that couple joint DOFs via a displacement-control actuator. Provides the display name and inherits actuator tuning parameters from superdex::experimental::DisplacementControlActuatorParams.
